SELECT query_id, user_agent, session_name, query_text, end_time, execution_time
            FROM md_information_schema.query_history
            ORDER BY end_time DESC NULLS LAST
            LIMIT 100

SELECT review_status, COUNT(*) AS n
            FROM qa.specimen_merge_review_queue_v1
            GROUP BY 1
            ORDER BY n DESC
SELECT * FROM qa.v_diag_specimen_review_burden_v1 ORDER BY queue_key
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM main.molecular_results

SELECT COALESCE(analyte_group, '(null)') AS analyte_group, COUNT(*) AS n
                FROM main.longitudinal_lab_deduped_v
                GROUP BY 1
                ORDER BY n DESC

SELECT COALESCE(analyte_group, '(null)') AS analyte_group, COUNT(*) AS n
                FROM main.longitudinal_lab_canonical_v1
                GROUP BY 1
                ORDER BY n DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows FROM qa.promotion_review_decisions

SELECT verification_status, COUNT(*) AS n
                FROM qa.manual_review_queue
                GROUP BY 1
                ORDER BY n DESC

SELECT
                  COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
                  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE verification_status IS NULL) AS pending_null_status,
                  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE verification_status IS NOT NULL) AS reviewed_non_null_status
                FROM qa.manual_review_queue

SELECT *

                ORDER BY created_at DESC NULLS LAST
                LIMIT 20

SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM qa.specimen_merge_review_queue_v1

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(n_rows), 0)
                    FROM qa.v_diag_specimen_review_burden_v1
                    WHERE queue_key = 'specimen_genomic_link_review'
                      AND LOWER(COALESCE(review_status, '')) IN ('open', 'pending', '')
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE TRIM(COALESCE(identity_build_run_id, '')) = '') FROM main.specimen_tumor_focus_v1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.specimen_genomic_assay_v1 g LEFT JOIN main.specimen_tumor_focus_v1 f ON g.specimen_focus_id = f.specimen_focus_id WHERE g.specimen_focus_id IS NOT NULL AND f.specimen_focus_id IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.specimen_tumor_focus_v1 f LEFT JOIN main.specimen_master_v1 m ON f.specimen_id = m.specimen_id WHERE m.specimen_id IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT focus_fingerprint_sha256 FROM main.specimen_tumor_focus_v1  GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) _t
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qa.val_specimen_genomic_binding_v1 WHERE UPPER(status) = 'FAIL'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qa.val_specimen_contract_v1 WHERE UPPER(status) = 'FAIL'
SELECT COUNT(*) = COUNT(DISTINCT specimen_fingerprint_sha256) FROM main.specimen_master_v1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.molecular_results WHERE superseded_by_molecular_result_id IS NULL

SELECT
            COUNT(*) AS n,
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE research_id IS NULL) AS n_rid,
            COUNT(*) FILTER (
                WHERE release_tag IS NULL
                OR trim(cast(release_tag AS VARCHAR)) = ''
            ) AS n_tag
        FROM main.master_patient_rollup_verified_v1
